head: working-tree
subject: RDS path-separated prefix matching
change: RouteMatch.path_separated_prefix (field 14) is now decoded and matched. The matcher compares the path with query and fragment removed, accepting either the exact prefix or the prefix followed by '/', so a gRPC service prefix such as /demo.Service matches /demo.Service/Get but not /demo.ServiceX/Get. Non-gRPC prefixes are skipped like other non-gRPC route paths, and invalid prefixes ending in '/' or containing '?'/'#' are rejected.

unit: src/grpc/xds/routing/tests.zig 'gRPC xDS routing path-separated prefixes stop at segment boundaries' covers exact, slash, query, fragment, case-insensitive and non-boundary cases.

src/grpc/xds/rds/tests.zig 'gRPC RDS matches path-separated prefixes' decodes field 14, selects /demo.Service/Get and /demo.Service/Get?x=1, rejects /demo.ServiceX/Get, and verifies an invalid trailing-slash prefix is skipped.

notes: This covers the literal path-separated prefix matcher. URI template path_match_policy and path_rewrite_policy remain open.
